elements.text: MASTER CLOUD SAAS SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENT (SLA)

Section 4.1 Service Availability: The Provider commits to delivering 99.99% monthly service uptime. Scheduled maintenance windows shall not exceed 2 hours per calendar month and require 7 days advance notice.

Section 4.2 Financial Service Credits: If monthly availability falls below 99.90% but exceeds 99.00%, Customer shall receive a 15% billing credit. If uptime drops below 99.00%, a 30% credit shall apply.
